name: exectime
description: Shared libc SP4: the exec budget -- the mean fork+exec+exit of /bin/echo (static, no libc.so at exec) and /testbin/dyntrue (dynamic, bound on the machine), 200 each so the first exec's cold read of the binary is a small share of the mean, and /testbin/dyntruebound (the same bound on the host, 20: it reads libc's four banks every exec).
